title: Lito's Datapack Bundle
body:
Made to keep the feel of Vanilla 1.19.4 while adding quality of life improvements.

This Bundle includes Lito's Recipes and Lito's Smelting.

 

Additions:

(Lito's Recipes)

- Slabs to Blocks (Ex: 2 Stone Slabs will make a Stone Block in recipe)

- Stairs to Blocks (Ex: 4 Stone Stairs will make 4 Stone Blocks in recipe; You may ask why 4? It's because between the stonecutter and crafting table you can duplicate blocks, this is to prevent that)

(Lito's Smelting)
- Raw Metal Blocks can be smelted (blasted) into their metal counterpart for a smelt time of 1080 (200 * 60% = Blast Furnace Default Time * 9 = 1080) ticks. (Blast Furnace Only)
